reviews.author: Mike Scism
reviews.text: These gentlemen are awesome. They're very knowledgeable and committed to the right stuff at a fare honest price. They schedule the work and follow up on all issues. I am so grateful for the shop and the owner, Gary. Thanks Mike

reviews.author: Dennis Elliott
reviews.text: These guys have done an excellent job for me multiple times. They are fairly priced and have a quick turnaround. They're transparent with how long a repair will take and what needs to be repaired. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Shelia Hayes
reviews.text: Very honest and saved me a lot of money. Good Christian man. Been a long time since I felt good about my mechanic and new as an elderly woman I was not taken advantage of.

reviews.author: Cliff Anderson
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about the service performed on my American V8 car from 2002. Not only did they find difficult parts, but offered service options to keep pricing in my control. Incredible personal service and skill tracking down “quirky” auto issues. The black Chevy pickup in the background also gets full attention to detail on the same level as my Ford Tbird sports car. If it’s an American car or Truck, they’re my No.1 choice year after year.

reviews.author: Carl Beam
reviews.text: Gary and Lenny are the best! Our family has used their shop for years and they always do an excellent job. They stand behind their work and always call if they find "something else." Appreciate their honesty! Great guys and superb workmanship.

reviews.author: William Parton
reviews.text: Very knowledgeable people. Extremely nice and easy to talk to. Very hard working to make sure your vehicle is taken care of. Definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Richard Elam
reviews.text: I have been doing business with cars since the mid 1980s. No reason to go to a big dealer when you get better service from these guys. I recommend them highly to anyone.

reviews.author: David Neild
reviews.text: I've delt with numerous mechanics over the years...but Cars Auto is the Best by far....they are reasonable...knowledgeable..courteous and professional

reviews.author: Dan Lovelace
reviews.text: No matter what the problem, They will take care of it. The only place I take my vehicles for service. Fast service and fair prices. You can't ask for more.
